hooks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "[Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager, Windows.UI.Notifications, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null; [Windows.Data.Xml.Dom.XmlDocument, Windows.Data.Xml.Dom.XmlDocument, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null; $template = @'<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><toast><visual><binding template=\"ToastText02\"><text id=\"1\">Claude Code</text><text id=\"2\">Claude Code cần bạn</text></binding></visual></toast>'@; $xml = New-Object Windows.Data.Xml.Dom.XmlDocument; $xml.LoadXml($template); $toast = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotification]::new($xml); [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::CreateToastNotifier('Claude Code').Show($toast)"
